_comment: Clinica Artica pilot batch (EPIC-002, SPEC-008 CA-3; ADR-003 §3-§4, ADR-005). Extends probe_config.json: providers, prices, currency and weights are inherited unchanged; this file replaces user_location and batch as a whole. Levels are read from the prompt id prefix (AV core, AR area of influence, AG Galicia) and are reported apart: each weighted SoV uses only its own level (AV for condition (D), AR for condition (C); ADR-009), AG only counts. Brands take part by membership (the list below), not by city: pilot brands based in Vigo or Pontevedra stay out of the Vigo batch (ADR-005 §5). Competitor sources and dates: SPEC-008 ledger.

batch.name: piloto-artica-viveiro
batch.title: Resumen del probe — piloto Clínica Ártica (lote Viveiro)

levels.label: núcleo: Viveiro y A Mariña (condición (D) del Go: defender)
área de influencia (condición (C) del Go: crecer; cifra solo de AR)

batch._runs_comment: Runs per level (SPEC-008 CA-5, CA-9 and CA-11 dictamens, 2026-09-29): AV 3 runs (official baseline and each Go 'after' measurement, condition (D)); AR 3 runs (the CA-12 'before' and each Go 'after' measurement of condition (C): same design on both sides); AG 1 run. Go 'after' measurement: --levels AV,AR. Tracking overrides with --runs 1 (weekly AV; AR/AG every 4 weeks). --runs overrides every selected level.

go._comment: Go criterion with the probe (SPEC-008 CA-9 and CA-11 dictamens, CA-10; ADR-009): ceiling warning when the core weighted SoV is >= ceiling (only AV, only the probe); a Go measurement is complete when every weighted provider has >= min_valid_share of its AV rows with status=ok (relaunch with --resume in the same week otherwise).
go._growth_comment: Condition (C), SPEC-008 CA-11 dictamen (ADR-009): weighted SoV of AR only (RN-03/RN-04 formula, runs pooled per provider), 'before' (CA-12) and two 'after' measurements with the same runs; Go of growth iff in EACH 'after' the rise is >= min_rise_pts (unrounded) and stays > 0 when any single AR question is left out on both sides.
go._defense_comment: Condition (D), SPEC-008 CA-11 dictamen: weighted core SoV (AV only) against the official baseline; significant drop iff it falls by >= max_drop_pts in BOTH 'after' measurements.

batch._client_review_aliases_comment: Client aliases that are also a common word (F-SPEC-008-3, CA-9 (h)): answers naming the client only through them still count (RN-01 literal) and are listed in summary.md for manual review.
